data.name: Fergus
data.gender_notes: Fergus is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Fergus is derived from the Old Irish word 'fer' meaning 'deer' and 'gos' meaning 'stranger'. This name was given to warriors in ancient Ireland, symbolizing strength, courage, and power in battle. Fergus is also a variant of the name Feargus, which means 'man of fear' or 'man of dread'. The name Fergus carries the meaning “Fierce, bold or strong one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Fergus usually hope their child will grow to embody fierce, bold or strong one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
